STS2_WINE_FOX_EVENT_DESERT_PYRAMID.title: Desert Temple
STS2_WINE_FOX_EVENT_DESERT_PYRAMID.pages: A vast desert suddenly appears before you, with a temple at its center. Sand trickles from cracks in the ceiling, and the air feels ancient and dangerous. You spot a dark sandstone platform at the bottom with several chests and a pressure plate. Go down and take a look?
Too dangerous. Better not stay here.
There are 3 chests. Which one will you open?
You open the chest. As expected, there's something good inside.
You find an enchanted book. The moment you touch the page, you feel stronger.
STS2_WINE_FOX_EVENT_HIDDEN_CHERRY_BLOSSO: You arrive in a grove where cherry blossoms drift through the air. You think you hear the sound of a wind bell, and a gentle breeze carries the petals as if guiding you somewhere. Your intuition tells you to follow.
Lose all Gold. Gain a card removal reward.

Deep within the cherry grove, you find an enormous cherry tree. Before a shrine inside its hollow rests a golden bell, tied with a red cord. Almost without thinking, you pick it up. It points you toward a new direction.

You hesitate and choose to leave carefully. After a moment of dizziness, the cherry grove from just now is gone. You feel somehow lighter, though for reasons unknown, you feel as if you missed something.
STS2_WINE_FOX_EVENT_HIDDEN_RETREAT.title: Hidden Retreat
STS2_WINE_FOX_EVENT_HIDDEN_RETREAT.pages:
"Ring the bell, the blossoms wake
In silent woods the soft winds break
An old friend waits with flowers in hand"
After a long trek, you arrive at a hidden retreat. It is an even larger cherry blossom grove, with signs of life in the dwelling at its center. You pat the little fox by the door, step inside, and see her seated in the middle of the room.
The bell's chime echoes through the room. The scent of cherry blossoms gathers into three different gifts. Which will you accept?
You hand the Seeking Wind Bell to her. The golden bell rings with a clear echo. Cherry blossoms drift on the wind, and a return gift settles quietly into your hands.
You choose not to disturb the peace of this place and turn to leave. As you step out of the grove, several cards carried by cherry petals float before you.
A thunderous crash tears through the sky, and the earth trembles beneath it. Looking toward the sound, you see a pillar of dust in the distance. The flames have not yet faded, and a charred, angular meteorite lies buried deep in the ground.
Lose [red]{HpLossPercent}%[/red] HP. Gain a colorless card reward.
The scorching meteorite burns your hand, but at least you found something worthwhile. This alien technological component can greatly improve your ability to handle complex crafting tasks.
The scorching meteorite burns your hand, but at least you found something worthwhile. Its outer shell should make fine forging material.
It might be some unknown monster. Better not touch it.
